verdict.rationale: Fivetran's own docs say each connector handles upstream schema changes automatically, so the core detection-and-propagation behavior is claimed. Nothing in the pack shows a user-selectable policy (for example, allow all, allow columns only, or block) governing how those changes are applied. missing for 10: a documented user-chosen schema change policy, detail on how changes are detected and propagated to the destination, alerting on schema changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, upstream schema changes are detected and propagated by a policy I choose, instead of silently breaking loads

citations.quote: Each connector handles schema changes, API updates, and incremental syncs automatically
